label: ajito_honoo_020_cassiopeia_01
text: I see you dealt with the grunt standing guard.\nNice work.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_honoo_020_cassiopeia_02
text: Stationed inside that base is Team Star’s Fire\ncrew—the Schedar Squad.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_honoo_020_cassiopeia_03
text: Their boss, Mela, is the best all-rounder of the\nteam. She fixes any and every problem thrown\r\nher way, though her methods are...heavy-handed.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_honoo_020_cassiopeia_04
text: Our declaration of war must have made her\nblood boil.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_honoo_020_cassiopeia_05
text: I bet even now, her grunts are hard at work inside\nthe base, trying to keep her fury under control.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_honoo_020_cassiopeia_06
text: That means your best move is to take down all\nthe grunts nice and quick.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_honoo_020_cassiopeia_07
text: Once there’s no one left to help Mela keep her\ncool, she should come out to confront you.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: ajito_honoo_020_cassiopeia_09
text: Ring the bell on the gates once you’re ready to\nkick off this phase of the operation.\c\nTime to wipe the Schedar Squad off the map![VAR 0x0114(0009)]
